---
title: "完全二叉树 Fp=[Cp/2]证明"
date: "2011-09-09"
categories: [imported, notes]
draft: false
---

完全二叉树 Fp=[Cp/2]

设:Fi,F在Fi行第x个.

Fp=2^(i-1)-1+x

Cp1=2^i-1+2x-1=2(2^(i-1)-1+x)=2Fp

Cp2=2^i-1+2x=2(2^(i-1)-0.5+x)=2(Fp+0.5)

Fp=Cp/2

Fp=Cp/2-0.5

所以Fp=[Cp/2]
